_comment: What changed in each release, in the words a shopkeeper would use. Unversioned on purpose: the running app fetches this by a stable URL to show what the INCOMING version brings, so a ?v= here would be a URL the old build cannot know. Newest first. tests/release-notes.test.mjs fails the build if the top entry does not match the stamp in app.html.

en: Every notice the app shows you now carries the SaviaSmart name and mark, with a glowing edge in one of three colours: green when it is just the app talking, amber when something wants your attention, red when money or data is at risk.
The payment report was leaving bank sales out of its combined total while still counting them in the number of sales. Bank now appears with the other ways you get paid.
sw: Kila taarifa programu inayokuonyesha sasa ina jina na alama ya SaviaSmart, ikiwa na ukingo unaong aa wa rangi moja kati ya tatu: kijani programu inapoongea tu, njano kitu kinapohitaji uangalizi wako, nyekundu fedha au taarifa zikiwa hatarini.
Ripoti ya malipo ilikuwa ikiacha mauzo ya benki nje ya jumla yake huku ikiyahesabu katika idadi ya mauzo. Benki sasa inaonekana pamoja na njia nyingine unazolipwa.

en: This list now appears in Swahili when the app is set to Swahili. It was showing English whichever language you had chosen.

In a customer history, the column beside a credit sale now says how much of that sale went on credit. It used to be headed as what is still owed, which never changed even after the customer paid. What is still owed is the running figure at the top of that window.
sw: Orodha hii sasa inaonekana kwa Kiswahili programu ikiwa imewekwa kwa Kiswahili. Ilikuwa ikionyesha Kiingereza bila kujali lugha uliyochagua.

Katika historia ya mteja, safu iliyo kando ya mauzo ya mkopo sasa inasema kiasi gani cha mauzo hayo kilienda kwa mkopo. Awali ilikuwa na kichwa cha kinachodaiwa, ambacho hakikubadilika hata mteja alipolipa. Kinachodaiwa ni takwimu inayoendelea juu ya dirisha hilo.

en: The message that tells you a new version is ready now wears the app's own colour and mark, instead of the yellow kept for things that need fixing.
sw: Ujumbe unaokuambia toleo jipya lipo tayari sasa unavaa rangi na alama ya programu yenyewe, badala ya njano inayotumika kwa vitu vinavyohitaji kurekebishwa.

en: When a new version is ready, you can now tap that message to see exactly what changed before you reload.
What changed in each update is also kept in Settings, so you can read it whenever you like.
sw: Toleo jipya likiwa tayari, sasa unaweza kugusa ujumbe ule ili uone hasa kilichobadilika kabla ya kupakia upya.
Kilichobadilika katika kila sasisho pia kinahifadhiwa kwenye Mipangilio, ili uweze kusoma wakati wowote.

en: Your stock value now updates the moment you record a delivery. Before this it could keep pricing the new quantity at the old buying price.
The Stock Valuation report no longer claims your products have no buying price when they do.
A customer history now shows what they were sold on credit at the till, not only invoices and payments, so the balance they owe can be followed.
The Cost of Goods Sold report now says how much stock left on invoices, so the difference against the profit on your dashboard is not mistaken for theft.
The Profit Report now says which branch it is showing.
sw: Thamani ya hisa yako sasa inasasishwa mara tu unaporekodi bidhaa zilizowasili. Kabla ya hapa iliweza kuendelea kupanga kiasi kipya kwa bei ya zamani ya ununuzi.
Ripoti ya Thamani ya Hisa haisemi tena kwamba bidhaa zako hazina bei ya ununuzi wakati zinayo.
Historia ya mteja sasa inaonyesha alichouziwa kwa mkopo kaunta, si ankara na malipo pekee, ili deni analodaiwa liweze kufuatiliwa.
Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inasema hisa kiasi gani ilitoka kwa ankara, ili tofauti na faida ya dashibodi yako isichukuliwe kama wizi.
Ripoti ya Faida sasa inasema tawi gani inaloonyesha.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now explains that supplier discounts are already inside what you paid, instead of leaving a blank figure that looked like missing data.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inaeleza kwamba punguzo la muuzaji tayari limo ndani ya ulicholipa, badala ya kuacha nafasi tupu iliyoonekana kama taarifa zilizokosekana.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now names the products that have no buying price, so you can go and fill them in.
It will not show a cost figure that cannot be true. If the sums come out impossible, it says so instead.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inataja bidhaa zisizo na bei ya ununuzi, ili uende ukazijaze.
Haitaonyesha takwimu ya gharama isiyoweza kuwa kweli. Hesabu zikitoka zisizowezekana, inasema hivyo badala yake.

en: The Cost of Goods Sold report now shows a partial figure clearly marked incomplete, rather than showing you nothing at all.
sw: Ripoti ya Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa sasa inaonyesha takwimu ya sehemu iliyowekewa alama wazi kuwa haijakamilika, badala ya kutokuonyesha chochote.

en: New report: Cost of Goods Sold. It works out what the goods you sold over a period actually cost you, from your opening stock, what you bought, and your closing stock.
sw: Ripoti mpya: Gharama ya Bidhaa Zilizouzwa. Inahesabu bidhaa ulizouza katika kipindi zilikugharimu kiasi gani hasa, kutokana na hisa ya kuanzia, ulichonunua, na hisa ya mwisho.
